item.title: Festival Tours
item.description: Festival tours showcasing Bhutanese Tshechus That’s Why UD Travels Is Best for You Festival Tourism Unique Divine Travels curates festival tours centered on Tshechus, scheduled according to the Bhutanese Lunar Calendar. Our signature experience is the Jampa Lhakhang Tshechu, known for its sacred rituals, cultural richness, and traditional arts. Season: March to April and September through December Day 1: Arrive in Paro Reception at the airport by Unique Divine guide and driver; Visit Ta Dzong museum showcasing Bhutanese art and artifacts; and Night halt in hotel.
